hulpke_kuusalo_naatanen_rosenberger.screenshot_attempt: web screenshot was attempted on relevant PDF pages but the host returned cache-miss errors; no visual inference from inaccessible figure pixels is used

triangle_group_choice.source_wording: for one of these (2,4,8) groups we can choose S,T,U

triangle_group_to_regular_octagon_geomet.reason: Figures 1-7 and the printed S,T,U words locate a chosen (2,4,8) triangle-group tower inside a regular Bolza octagon and give exact surface-group side-pairing words.

triangle_group_S_fixed_point_to_algebrai.missing: The source says only that the fixed point of S is a Weierstrass point; it does not name it as infinity, 0, +1, -1, +i or -i.

triangle_group_T_fixed_point_to_algebrai.missing: The source says only that the fixed point of T is a Weierstrass point; it does not assign one of the six algebraic branch labels.

surface_group_f1_f4_to_kuusalo_canonical.missing: The 2005 f1,...,f4 are genus-2 covering-group diagonal-pairing generators. The source does not identify these names with Kuusalo's canonical homology basis (a1,a2,b1,b2); notation f1 also conflicts with Kuusalo 1995's order-8 automorphism name.

triangle_group_to_kuusalo_figure9_side_n.missing: No printed assignment connects the 2005 octagon's diagonal-pairing/triangle-group placement to Kuusalo Figure-9 side numbers 1,2,3,4.

triangle_group_order3_center_to_kuusalo_.missing: Example 1 uses a (2,4,8) triangle group with orders 2,4,8 and does not source-identify the chosen Kuusalo Figure-10 order-3 triangle center P. The ambient (2,3,8) normalizer is named, but no literal order-3 generator/triangle is bound to algebraic labels.

new_information_over_r6: The source returns to the same regular-octagon presentation family as Kuusalo Case D rather than Brezhnev's modular 10/18-gon.
It gives exact triangle-group and genus-2 surface-group words, so the hyperbolic group presentation is no longer the missing datum.
remaining_phase_obstruction: The chosen (2,4,8) subgroup is one of three conjugates in (2,3,8).
The distinguished fixed points of S and T are not assigned algebraic Weierstrass labels.
No side number or canonical H1 basis vector is attached to the algebraically labelled side centers.
No order-3 triangle center is identified with Kuusalo Figure-10 P.
ambiguity_analysis.consequence: The source upgrades the unmarked regular-octagon group geometry but does not supply the algebraic-label-to-octagon-phase adapter required to choose one R4 conjugate.

decision.next_source_candidate: Joseph Cook, Properties of Eigenvalues on Riemann Surfaces with Large Symmetry Groups, arXiv:2108.11825, especially Figures 1.7 and 3.1-3.2 / Jenni-derived R,S,T,U action.
decision.next_question: Cook explicitly constructs the octagon from algebraic branch labels and later labels the order-8 rotation R and order-3 triangle-center rotation U on the same Bolza tessellation. Does the text/figures explicitly identify the Figure-1.7 branch-labelled Weierstrass points with the P/Q labels used for R,U strongly enough to select the Kuusalo phase?
